hooks.command: f=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(d).tool_input.file_path||'')}catch{process.stdout.write('')}})"); case "$f" in apps/crawler/*) rel="${f#apps/crawler/}"; (cd apps/crawler && pnpm exec prettier --write "$rel" 2>/dev/null); ;; esac; true

cmd=$(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(d).tool_input.command||'')}catch{process.stdout.write('')}})"); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) (cd apps/crawler && pnpm --silent typecheck && pnpm --silent lint && pnpm --silent test) || exit 2 ;; esac
